change: AIOPS-412: prevent cross-tenant slot conflicts in scheduling

findings.comment: Consider naming the early return condition (e.g. different_tenants) for readability.
A boundary test where one slot ends exactly when the other starts would document intent.
A future change could move tenant scoping into the repository layer so callers cannot forget it.
The scheduling guide still says conflicts are global; update it so support staff are not misled.
Clear regression test that would fail if tenant scoping regressed.
